dialogue.origin: (こんばんは、本日はよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.content: (Good evening, thank you for coming in today.)

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員です。年齢、性別、ご相談内容をお聞かせください。
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm your counselor. Could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 40歳、女性です。自肯定感が低くてどうしたら、自分に自信がもてるか？と思ってます
dialogue.content: I’m 40 and female. I have low self-esteem, and I’m wondering how I can build confidence in myself.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。教えていただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: I see. Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.origin: いつごろからそんな風に思われていらっしゃるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Around when did you start feeling this way?

dialogue.origin: いつ頃かなー？
dialogue.content: Hmm, I wonder when it started...

dialogue.origin: ええ、どんな時にそう感じられますか？
dialogue.content: I see. In what situations do you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: 20過ぎに一人暮らしを始めてから、少し自分で、前向きに考えて動けるようになったんですけど…
dialogue.content: After I started living on my own in my early twenties, I became a little more able to think positively and take action for myself, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 病気してから、かも知れません
dialogue.content: It might be since I got sick.

dialogue.origin: 最近漸く落ち着いて来たんですが
dialogue.content: Things have finally started to settle down recently, though.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: たまに落ち込んだ時とかは、特にですかね
dialogue.content: Especially when I feel down sometimes, I suppose.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・。落ち込んだ時はそのように思われますよね。
dialogue.content: That makes sense. It's natural to feel that way when you're feeling down.

dialogue.origin: ご病気をされたとのことですが、今はどのような生活を送っていますか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned you were ill. What is your life like now?

dialogue.origin: でも、なんかそれだけでもないような…
dialogue.content: But it feels like it’s not just that...

dialogue.origin: 子供の頃は特に自己肯定感は低かったように感じます
dialogue.content: I feel like my self-esteem was especially low when I was a child.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's how it was.

dialogue.origin: 両親、特に父親の関わり方…ですかね
dialogue.content: The way my parents, especially my father, treated me... I suppose.

dialogue.origin: いつも、否定的な言葉をかけられてました
dialogue.content: He always said negative things to me.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうだったのですね。それは辛かったですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must have been very difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: 高校生の時は(電車に)「もう間に合わねー、もう間に合わねー」と言われ続けて
dialogue.content: When I was in high school, he would constantly tell me about the train, "You're not going to make it, you're not going to make it."

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: でも、実際は一度も間に合わなかったことはなくて
dialogue.content: But in reality, I never once missed it.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: Right, I see.

dialogue.origin: 皆勤賞だったんですよ
dialogue.content: I even got a perfect attendance award.

dialogue.origin: それはすごいですね！
dialogue.content: That's amazing!

dialogue.origin: そもそも、その電車だって、一本前の早い電車で
dialogue.content: Besides, that was an early train to begin with, the one before the one I needed.

dialogue.origin: ちゃんと自分で時間を計算して毎日頑張っていたのですね。
dialogue.content: You properly calculated the time yourself and worked hard every day.

dialogue.origin: 次の電車でも間に合うように、行ってましたから
dialogue.content: I was going early enough that even the next train would have gotten me there on time.

dialogue.origin: しっかりしていますね。
dialogue.content: That’s very responsible of you.

dialogue.origin: 父に急かされないで、家を出ると、いつも駅で待つんです
dialogue.content: When I left the house without my father rushing me, I would always end up waiting at the station.

dialogue.origin: それが、嫌で
dialogue.content: I hated that.

dialogue.origin: 要は早すぎるんですよ
dialogue.content: Basically, it was just too early.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。工夫されていたのですね。嫌な思いをしないように・・
dialogue.content: I see. You were being resourceful so you could avoid those unpleasant feelings.

dialogue.origin: でも、待つのも嫌でしたよね
dialogue.content: But waiting must have been unpleasant too, right?

dialogue.origin: でも、私が間に合うと思う時間に家を出る時は、父にうるさく言われるので
dialogue.content: But when I left at the time I thought would be just enough to make it, my father would nag me.

dialogue.origin: それは気持ち的にも負担がありましたよね
dialogue.content: That must have been an emotional burden, right?

dialogue.origin: 他にも病気して、自分で病院に連れて行って欲しいと頼んだ時に、小さなトラブルがあって
dialogue.content: Another time, I was sick and asked him to take me to the hospital, and there was a little trouble.

dialogue.origin: ええ、
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: その時、「入院しちまぇ！」って言われたんです😭
dialogue.content: At that time, he said, "Why don’t you just get yourself hospitalized already!" 😭

dialogue.origin: え・・それは悲しいですよね・・。その時どう感じたのですか？
dialogue.content: Oh... that’s heartbreaking. How did you feel then?

dialogue.origin: 凄く苦しくて、今でもハッキリと覚えてて、トラウマですね
dialogue.content: It was extremely painful. I remember it vividly even now, and it's a trauma for me.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・。トラウマにもなりますよね。。今はどなたと暮らしているのですか？
dialogue.content: I can imagine. It would certainly be traumatic. Who are you living with now?

dialogue.origin: もう辛くて、言葉になりません
dialogue.content: It’s so painful, I can’t even put it into words.

dialogue.origin: それはそうだと思います・・。
dialogue.content: I'm sure it is.

dialogue.origin: 今は子供と2人暮らしですが、すぐ近くに両親がいるので
dialogue.content: I live with my child now, just the two of us, but my parents live very close by.

dialogue.origin: 実家に行くんですけど、最近母も病気してもう治らなくて
dialogue.content: I visit my parents' house, but recently my mother also got sick, and it's incurable.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・。
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 大好きな母が変わっていくのを見てるのも辛いんです
dialogue.content: It's painful watching my beloved mother changing.

dialogue.origin: でも父の母への関わり方がひどくて、ホント嫌になります
dialogue.content: But the way my father treats my mother is terrible, and I really hate it.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうですよね胸が苦しいですよね・・。お父様はどんな風にお母様に接しているのですか？？
dialogue.content: Yes, I can imagine that's heartbreaking. How does your father treat your mother?

dialogue.origin: 最近頭の病気とか、骨折した後だったりして、意識がハッキリしてる時と
dialogue.content: Lately, due to a brain condition and after a bone fracture, there are times when she's lucid...

dialogue.origin: 寝てる事が多かったりする事があって
dialogue.content: ...and other times when she sleeps a lot.

dialogue.origin: ええ。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 体の左側に麻痺があるので、ウトウトしてて、左側に転んでしまうんですよ
dialogue.content: She has paralysis on the left side of her body, so when she dozes off, she falls to the left.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは心配ですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must be worrying.

dialogue.origin: それが、最近顕著に現れてて頻回になって来たんです
dialogue.content: That's been happening more noticeably and frequently lately.

dialogue.origin: すると、父が「もう、どーしよーもねーなー」とか
dialogue.content: And when that happens, my father says things like, "She’s just hopeless..."

dialogue.origin: 「頭おかしいんだこの女」とか言ったりするんです
dialogue.content: or "This woman is crazy."

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・。あなたも面倒を見に行っていて、そういったことを目にすると辛く、悲しいですよね・・。
dialogue.content: I see. When you go to help take care of her and see things like that, it must be painful and sad for you.

dialogue.origin: 父には、いくら、母の病状を説明しても、ハッキリいって、全く分からなくて
dialogue.content: No matter how much I explain my mother's condition to my father, to be blunt, he just doesn't get it at all.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: もうホント嫌になります
dialogue.content: I'm just so sick of it.

dialogue.origin: それはそうだと思います。トラウマもあるので、、
dialogue.content: I can certainly understand that, especially with the trauma you have...

dialogue.origin: 父は人の意見に耳を貸さないので、自分が耳が遠いことも、気付いてないようで
dialogue.content: My father doesn't listen to others' opinions, so he doesn't seem to realize that he's hard of hearing himself.

dialogue.origin: ええ。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 最近特に大声で話すから、私も耳が痛くて
dialogue.content: He speaks so loudly lately that it hurts my ears.

dialogue.origin: 大声を出されると威圧感ありますよね
dialogue.content: Being spoken to in a loud voice can feel intimidating, can't it?

dialogue.origin: けど、それを指摘すると絶対否定すると思いますし、補聴器のことなんて提案したら、怒り💢爆発💥だと思います
dialogue.content: But if I point it out, I'm sure he'll deny it, and if I were to suggest a hearing aid, I think he'd explode with anger. 💢💥

dialogue.origin: それは困りますよね・・。
dialogue.content: That puts you in a difficult position, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: 母には昨年補聴器を作ってもらったんですけど、
dialogue.content: We had a hearing aid made for my mother last year, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 身体に入ってる器械とハウリングするらしく
dialogue.content: Apparently, it causes feedback with a medical device she has in her body,

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 付けたがらないので、母も耳は遠いですが、
dialogue.content: so she doesn't want to wear it. My mother is also hard of hearing, but...

dialogue.origin: 父よりは全然良いですね
dialogue.content: her hearing is much better than my father’s.

dialogue.origin: ええ。そうでしたか。あなたからみてどんなお母様なんですか？
dialogue.content: I see. From your perspective, what is your mother like?

dialogue.origin: そんな父親に小さい頃から育てられたから、と言うのは大きいと思いま
dialogue.content: I think a big part of it is being raised by a father like that since I was little.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: That makes sense.

dialogue.origin: 私は母とは何でも話せる仲良しですが、最近気付いた事は、私は母の言うことに同調してたな、と思う事があります
dialogue.content: I’m very close with my mother and can talk to her about anything, but I’ve recently realized that I tended to just agree with whatever she said.

dialogue.origin: 余り話が通じなくなってから
dialogue.content: Ever since it's become harder to communicate with her,

dialogue.origin: あ、時々ですね
dialogue.content: Oh, just sometimes, I mean.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・。仲が良かったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. You two were very close.

dialogue.origin: なんでも話せるお母様の体調が悪くなって寂しい気持ちもありますよね・・。
dialogue.content: It must be lonely now that your mother, who you could talk to about anything, is unwell.

dialogue.origin: だから、私が最近感じた事は、私は女ですけど、マザコンだったのかも？と思う事があります。
dialogue.content: That's why I've recently started to feel that, even though I'm a woman, maybe I was a bit of a "mama’s girl."

dialogue.origin: そう思われるのですね
dialogue.content: That's how you see it.

dialogue.origin: それほど仲がいいってことですね
dialogue.content: It just shows how close you were.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、私、仏教徒なんですけど、唯一仏教の話が身近で話せる存在でして
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm a Buddhist, and she was the only person close to me I could easily talk with about Buddhism.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ははの具合が悪くなって、次第に衰えていくのを見てるのは辛いです
dialogue.content: It's painful to see my mother's condition worsen and watch her gradually decline.

dialogue.origin: だから、一時実家に行くのをやめてた時があります
dialogue.content: That's why there was a time when I stopped going to my parents' house.

dialogue.origin: そうだと思います。大好きな人が変わっていく姿を見るのは辛く、悲しくもありますよね。。
dialogue.content: I can imagine. It's painful and sad to see someone you love change like that.

dialogue.origin: 色々、あって多分自信がないんだと思います。
dialogue.content: With everything that's happened, I think that's probably why I lack confidence.

dialogue.origin: それで、一人暮らしを始めて、前向きに行動的になったんですけど、
dialogue.content: And so, when I started living alone, I became more positive and proactive, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 多分父から離れてかなー？
dialogue.content: Probably because I was away from my father?

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。ひとり暮らししてお父様から離れてそう感じたのですね・・。
dialogue.content: I see. So you felt that way after you started living on your own and were away from your father.

dialogue.origin: その後、病気して最近誤診だった事が判明して
dialogue.content: After that, I got sick, and it was recently discovered that it had been a misdiagnosis.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・
dialogue.content: Oh, I see.

dialogue.origin: それまで、ずっと苦しい状態が続いていたから、
dialogue.content: Because I had been in such a painful state for so long until then,

dialogue.origin: かな？とは、思います
dialogue.content: that might be part of the reason, I think.

dialogue.origin: ずっと今まで苦しい思いを抱えながら、頑張ってきたのですね。
dialogue.content: You've been carrying this painful burden and persevering all this time.

dialogue.origin: 何せ、20年近く誤った治療だったので、薬が合ってなかったんですよね
dialogue.content: After all, it was the wrong treatment for nearly 20 years, so the medication wasn't right for me.

dialogue.origin: 昨年の今頃キチンと診断がついて、漸く落ち着いたんです
dialogue.content: I got a proper diagnosis around this time last year, and things have finally settled down.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: でも、また最近波があるから、
dialogue.content: But lately, there have been ups and downs again, so...

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 気分が落ちた時？特に自信がなくになるのかな？
dialogue.content: When I feel down? I wonder if that's when I particularly lose my confidence.

dialogue.origin: あと、病気になった負い目ですかね。
dialogue.content: And also a sense of guilt about having gotten sick, perhaps.

dialogue.origin: 世間の目とか…
dialogue.content: And what other people think...

dialogue.origin: 20年近くもそういった状況だったのですから、そう思われるのも自然なことかもしれません・・。
dialogue.content: Considering you were in that situation for nearly 20 years, it's probably natural to feel that way.

dialogue.origin: 気持ちだって不安定になって当然だと思います。よくおひとりで抱えてこられましたね
dialogue.content: It's completely understandable that your emotions would be unstable. You've done so well to carry this on your own all this time.

dialogue.origin: 「私は私で良いじゃない」と思うのですが、多分そう思ってない自分、がいるのかも知れません
dialogue.content: I think, "It's okay to be just the way I am," but then there's probably a part of me that doesn't really believe it.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます🙇‍♀️
dialogue.content: Thank you. 🙇‍♀️

dialogue.origin: やっぱり、周りの目を気にしないで生きるって、凄く難しいんだな、と思います
dialogue.content: I guess it's just really difficult to live without worrying about what other people think.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうですよね・・。気になってしまいますよねでも、あなたはよく頑張っています。お父様やお母様のことだって。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's true... It's hard not to worry about it. But you're doing a great job, with your parents' situation too.

dialogue.origin: よく客観的に見れているし、お自身のこともよくわかっているように感じます
dialogue.content: I feel that you're able to see things very objectively, and that you understand yourself well.

dialogue.origin: マイノリティの人とかって、本当に苦しいでしょうね
dialogue.content: People in minorities must really suffer, don't they?

dialogue.origin: 生きるって、大変ですね
dialogue.content: Life is tough, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・周りの人に分かってもらえない苦しさや寂しさはありますよね・・。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's true... There's a pain and loneliness that comes from not being understood by the people around you.

dialogue.origin: 人って何の為に生きているんでしょう？
dialogue.content: What do people live for?

dialogue.origin: どんな時に生きるのは大変と感じますか？
dialogue.content: When do you feel that life is hard?

dialogue.origin: 自分の意見に素直に生きられない時とか
dialogue.content: When I can't live true to my own opinions.

dialogue.origin: 私は多分素直じゃないんじゃないかなと思います
dialogue.content: I think I'm probably not being honest with myself.

dialogue.origin: だから、周りの目を気にしないで、素直に生きていきたいです。
dialogue.content: That's why I want to live honestly, without worrying about what other people think.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・どんな時に素直じゃないと感じますか？好きな人に対してでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see... In what situations do you feel you're not being honest? Is it toward people you like, perhaps?

dialogue.origin: けど、さっきもお話したように、周囲の目はすごーく気にしてると思うから
dialogue.content: But, as I said before, I think I worry a great deal about what other people think.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね・・。どうしたら素直に生きられそうですか？
dialogue.content: I see. What do you think would help you to live more honestly?

dialogue.origin: 相手が私にとって都合の良い事を言ってくれた時とか…
dialogue.content: Like, when someone says something that's convenient for me...

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: Yes, I see.

dialogue.origin: 実はそんな風に思ってはいないんじゃないかな？とか
dialogue.content: I start to wonder, "Do they really think that?"

dialogue.origin: ええ。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 口では上手く言うけど、内心は…みたいな
dialogue.content: Like, they say all the right things, but I wonder what they're feeling inside...

dialogue.origin: どうしたら、素直に生きられるか…分からないですね
dialogue.content: How can I live more honestly...? I just don't know.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そう感じているのですね・・。自信のなさがそう思わせているのかな？と感じていますか？
dialogue.content: I see, that's how you're feeling. Do you feel that your lack of confidence might be what's making you think that way?

dialogue.origin: んー？それも分からないです
dialogue.content: Hmm... I’m not sure about that either.

dialogue.origin: 病気になった負い目？かも知れません
dialogue.content: Maybe it’s the sense of guilt from getting sick?

dialogue.origin: 世間の目、偏見…
dialogue.content: The way society looks at you, the prejudice...

dialogue.origin: 好きで病気になったわけじゃないし、治らないのは仕方ないのに、自分ではどうすることも出来ないのに…って
dialogue.content: It's not like I chose to get sick, and I can't help that it's incurable. There's nothing I can do about it myself, and yet...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。頭でわかってても心がついていかない時もあるかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: That’s right. There are times when you understand it in your head, but your heart just can't keep up.

dialogue.origin: 無理しすぎて、病気になっちゃぅたんですよ
dialogue.content: I overdid it and ended up getting sick.

dialogue.origin: そうあったんですね。頑張ってきたのですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what happened. You've been pushing yourself so hard.

dialogue.origin: だから、何であの時無理しすぎちゃったのかなー？😭って凄く後悔しています
dialogue.content: So I have this huge regret, thinking, "Why did I push myself so hard back then?" 😭

dialogue.origin: 一方で、「後悔しても仕方ないから、前を向いていこう」と思うんですが、そこで、複雑な気持ちなんですよね
dialogue.content: On the other hand, I think, "There's no point in regretting it, so I should look forward," but that's where I have these complicated feelings.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね・・複雑な気持ちになりますよね
dialogue.content: I see... It's natural to feel conflicted.

dialogue.origin: 頑張って無理してしまって・・とせめてしまったり、悔やんだり・・
dialogue.content: Blaming yourself for pushing too hard, and feeling so much regret...

dialogue.origin: 後悔しても、過去は変えられないけど、未来は今の生き方次第でいくらでも変わるじゃないですか…
dialogue.content: Even if I have regrets, I can't change the past, but the future can change in all sorts of ways depending on how I live now, right?

dialogue.origin: そう頭で分かってても、感情はついていかれないんですよ
dialogue.content: I know that in my head, but my emotions can't keep up.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね・・でもここに相談にきたのは前を向いて後悔しないように生きていきたいからですよね
dialogue.content: That's right... But the reason you came here for counseling today is because you want to look forward and live a life without regrets, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: だから、後悔してる自分を受け入れられてないかも知れません
dialogue.content: So maybe I haven't been able to accept the part of myself that has regrets.

dialogue.origin: そんな気持ちが伝わってきます
dialogue.content: I can sense that from what you're saying.

dialogue.origin: 受け入れられる時がくるまで、待っていてもいいのかもしれません・・。
dialogue.content: It might be okay to just wait until the time comes when you can accept it.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、自分に素直になって、前向きに生きたいですね
dialogue.content: You're right. I want to be honest with myself and live more positively.

dialogue.origin: こんなにも悩んで苦しんででも前を向いていこうとしているのですから、きっと受け入れられる時がくると思います。あなたはどう思われますか？
dialogue.content: You've been struggling and suffering so much, yet you're still trying to look forward. I believe the time will come when you can accept it. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 受け入れられる日ってくるでしようか？
dialogue.content: Will a day ever come when I can accept it?

dialogue.origin: あなたが諦めない限りくると思います
dialogue.content: I believe it will, as long as you don’t give up.

dialogue.origin: 私はなんか、何もしなければ、受け入れられる日は来ない気がします
dialogue.content: I have a feeling that if I don't do anything, that day will never come.

dialogue.origin: いつか…と考えると苦しいです
dialogue.content: It's painful to think "someday..."

dialogue.origin: 今まで20年苦しんできたので
dialogue.content: Because I've already been suffering for 20 years.

dialogue.origin: 病気以外にも大きな出来事はありましたし。
dialogue.content: And there have been other major events in my life besides the illness.

dialogue.origin: そう思うのですね・・。
dialogue.content: That’s how you feel.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうなんですね
dialogue.content: Yes, I see.

dialogue.origin: 私にとっては病気になった事で、自分という存在が全く別人なように感じられるんです
dialogue.content: For me, getting sick makes me feel like I’m a completely different person.

dialogue.origin: 病気になる前となった後の自分が…です
dialogue.content: The me before the illness and the me after...

dialogue.origin: そう思われているのですね・。それはとても辛いと思います。ここまでたくさんお話を聞かせて頂いたのですが、相談終了のお時間になってしまいました。次回でもよろしければ、一緒に前を向いていくために何ができるのかを一緒に話せたらと思います。
dialogue.content: That's how you feel... I imagine that is very painful. We've talked about so much today, but our time for this session has come to an end. If you'd like, in our next session, we could talk together about what we can do to help you move forward.

dialogue.origin: わかりました
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 病気になる前となった後の自分が別人だと人生が変わってしまったと感じていると思います。お話足りなかったと思います。またいらして頂けたら続きをお話聞かせてください。
dialogue.content: It sounds like you feel your life has completely changed, as if the person you were before your illness and the person you are now are two different people. I'm sure there was more you wanted to talk about. Please come back again so we can continue our conversation.

dialogue.origin: 今日はこちらに来ていただいてありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: （貴重なお時間ありがとうございました。また機会があればよろしくお願いします）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your valuable time. I hope we can speak again.)

dialogue.origin: 終了メッセージ流します
dialogue.content: I'll send the closing message now.

topic.sub: 自己肯定感の低下とその背景
